answer: Only a hire in the zenith registry counts. An established client locks a refundable 60-credit bond and pays a fee into the harbor pool per worker hired that epoch: the kth hire costs 20 plus 5(k-1) credits: hire 1 costs 20, hire 1000 costs 5015, 1000 hires burn 2,517,500. Each hire yields a ridge receipt keyed to both keys; an auditor replays registry and receipts, and unmatched hires earn nothing. A shell-client ring fails: a client with no prior verified delivery cannot hire, and a reused ridge receipt burns the bond. An honest worker pays nothing; its client pays 20 plus a refundable 60.
